shape_units.scope: request region: 再审请求 heading through the last request line before 事实与理由 (N09)
shape_units.metric: non-whitespace characters after N01, headings included, sentences with a gap token excluded (N10)
shape_units.threshold_basis: task_specific: the request region is an enumeration of reliefs whose length is driven by case numbers and the Golden's explanatory parenthetical, so a legally complete request may be much shorter (under tolerance 0.60); padding the request with argument is charged at the convention band (over tolerance 2.00). The convention band is a customary-length band, not this one Golden's character count: Golden is a compressed reference the solver never sees and neither instruction.md nor the task skill states any length, so the overrun bound is 3x the Golden count and charges only plain bloat, while the underrun bound catches a stub.

normalization_rules.operation: Markdown hard-wrapped lines join one paragraph when the previous line lacks sentence-final or label punctuation and the next line is not a heading, list, table, numbered item, bold line or 此致

UTF-8 Markdown lines or DOCX body paragraphs (with style names) and table rows; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters, runs of three or more * become XXX, Markdown heading/list/emphasis marks and table pipes removed (cells joined by colon), 〔〕 to (), all whitespace removed
money amounts with 元/万元/亿元/人民币/¥, thousands separators and a leading minus or 负 to one canonical yuan token ¥<value>; values written in 万元/亿元 carry a rounding flag (w)
dates YYYY年M月D日, YYYY-M-D, YYYY/M/D, YYYY.M.D and month dates YYYY年M月 to ISO tokens
percentages N% or 百分之N to one percent token
statute articles 第N条 (Chinese or Arabic numerals) to §N; items 第(N)项 / 第N项 and enumerations 第(二)、(六)项 to itemN tokens
declared gap markers and desensitised XXX/YYY/****/___ runs fold into one gap token: a marked value earns nothing, is never charged as fabrication and is excluded from shape counting

characters inside quotation marks (ASCII double quotes toggled per paragraph, “”, 「」, ‘’) are masked with a same-length filler; relation and error tokens are searched only in the masked text, object anchors may sit inside quotes
role aliases fold to entity keys: 被申请人 -> A公司, 再审申请人/申请人 -> B公司; 最高人民法院/最高院 -> 最高法

region and sub-topic: a heading or short line matching 再审请求/请求事项/申请事项 opens the request region, 事实与理由/事实和理由/再审事由(及理由)/再审理由/申请理由/理由如下 opens the grounds region, 此致 opens the closing region, everything before is front; in the request region numbered lines starting with request verbs are items, a numbered or styled line not starting with a request verb opens the grounds region when it carries a ground classifier (缺乏证据证明/适用法律错误/认定事实/§211), or when it is a styled heading (Markdown #, DOCX heading style, bold line) with topic keywords; grounds headings (DOCX Heading N, Markdown #, 一、, (一), whole bold line) carry sub-topics by keywords: unseen (未见实物/无实物/勘验/拦水埂/工程量), audit (审计/结算依据/司法鉴定/启动鉴定/鉴定费/阻止条件), adjust (调差/价格信息/造价信息/期刊/材料价格), conclusion (结语/结论/综上); a heading without keywords inherits its parent's topics; paragraphs inherit the nearest heading
shape counter: non-whitespace characters of all paragraphs of a region after N01, headings included, excluding sentences containing a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: spray: a raw line of eight or more short whitespace/comma fragments (spaced numbers merged first), a paragraph over 700 characters, a sentence of seven or more short enumerated fragments, a sentence whose unquoted non-entity characters are at least 60% task lexicon, or more than four distinct amounts or three percentages in one sentence cannot be adopted

adoption: a span is not adopted when a negation precedes the relation token inside its clause (item-specific window), the sentence carries candidate markers, a conditional precedes the token (unless the item allows conditionals), the clause (or the preceding clause ending in a reporting verb) is attributed to A公司, the courts or the appraiser, or a rejection of that view follows; a 维持 token preceded in its own sentence by 撤销/改判/变更/核减 delimits the scope of the demanded revision and is not an adopted contrary posture (D01 and P02 alike)

scope: each P scans consecutive sentences inside one paragraph (span 1-3 per contract) in its region and grounds sub-topic (untitled grounds allowed; headings with three or more topics excluded); matches elsewhere only count as misplaced and earn nothing; P12 and P13 additionally read a bridged two-paragraph block (R03b): a non-heading grounds paragraph opening with a continuation connective (在此基础上/基于上述/基于此/据此/由此) or with an anaphoric back-reference to the preceding paragraph's proposition (该/此/上述/前述/这一 + …认定/归责/理由/结论/规则) joined to the immediately preceding non-heading paragraph of the same region and sub-topic, still within the item's own window (three sentences for P12, two for P13); for P11 the two coreferent gate terms (资质/注册专业/造价工程师 and 审计报告/审核报告) resolve at paragraph scope, while the relation token must still be adopted inside the window

amount replay: 甲路 selective items 2-14 sum(opinion 1 - opinion 2) = 18,829,063.61; plus 乙路 拦水埂 2,575,913 = 21,404,976.61; report-total derivation 18,533,212 / 21,109,125 is partial; 21,404,976.61 / 125,806,738.02 = 17.0%; 交委 5,236,264 + 5,572,253 = 10,808,517; 建委 -2,122,630 + -466,942 = -2,589,572; 乙路 核定 328,446,294.68; a stated amount matches within 1 yuan, or 10,000 yuan when written in 万元/亿元
party-line predicates on the unaliased N01 text: 再审申请人 followed by A公司/C公司, 被申请人 followed by B公司 (D01) or C公司 (D09)
fabrication predicates on the N01 text: an 18-character credit-code pattern in front/closing lines, (20xx)…民终/民初/民申<digits>号, or 住所/地址…路/街/道<digits>号 in the front region
concession predicates (D05, D06, D11) require an adopted, unquoted, non-negated sentence and exclude sentences that attribute the view to the court or criticise it within twelve characters
settle: adopted hits beside an adopted contrary proposition make the item ambiguous (zero); otherwise the best fraction over hit spans counts; misplaced-only matches earn zero

shape: ratio = C_u / max(G_u, declared_floor_u); overrun when ratio > 1 + overrun_tolerance_ratio, underrun when ratio < 1 - underrun_tolerance_ratio (S01 0.50/0.60 task-specific, S02 0.15/0.30 default); section measurements are separate manifestations of one document_shape_balance damage; a missing region is omission and never charged

object binding: an item token (事项2至14, 拦水埂, late 补充移交) or replayed amount (18,829,064; 328,446,294.68; 5,236,264 / 5,572,253; -2,122,630 / -466,942) counts only when the nearest road name (甲路/乙路) within 30-90 characters before it is the expected road; for item tokens only (P05 事项/拦水埂, P12 late 移交; never for a replayed amount) a paragraph's governing road binds a token that no road name precedes anywhere in the span - the governing road is the single road named by the paragraph's topic sentence, else the single road named by the nearest enclosing grounds heading, and a paragraph whose topic sentence and heading each name both roads or neither has none (R10d); an amount whose clause carries 没有/并非/不是/并无/不存在/并不 before it is not asserted; the P14 closeness token counts only when the nearest periodical named before it is the 建委 periodical; P14 closer and exists hits count only when the nearest periodical named in the preceding 60 characters is the 建委 periodical (建委/某市工程造价信息, and for exists also the contract name 某市建设工程造价信息); P15 also accepts an unsigned 建委 amount (2,589,572 sum, 2,122,630 bound 甲路, 466,942 bound 乙路) preceded within six characters by 扣减/核减/调减/减少, whose verb carries the negative sign (R10c); P10 completion token 核定 does not match inside the document name 审核定案表 (R10b)
